outfit.name: 武陵白绿中式原作衣装
outfit.prose: her original white-and-celadon sleeveless Chinese-style top with a dark high neckline and black structured waist harness, separate black-and-white arm sleeves, black gloves, a layered black belt with small hanging ornaments, wide flowing green trousers with pale upper panels and dark patterned hems, and black boots
